author: TEDx Talks
description:
What if the most advanced technology in your workflow is quietly making you less of yourself?

Creative Technologist TJ Nealy opens up about a pattern he didn’t notice until it was already happening — defaulting to AI before trusting his own instincts. From sorting 400 family videos to abandoning a bold design idea he never even tested, TJ traces the subtle ways AI can shift from a tool into the voice we trust most.

This isn’t an anti-AI talk. It’s a wake-up call.

In this talk, TJ introduces the concept of Creative Sovereignty — a framework for using AI critically and ethically without surrendering your perspective, your instincts, or your creative identity. You’ll learn how to distinguish between cloud and local AI models, define your own creative non-negotiables, and why practicing deliberate inefficiency might be the most productive thing you can do.

If you’ve ever accepted an AI suggestion without knowing exactly why — this one’s for you. Terrence “TJ” Nealy is a creative techn
title: How to tell if you’re using AI too much | Terrence "TJ" Nealy | TEDxCharlotte

author: TEDx Talks
description: Pediatric cancer affects 14,000 children every year in the United States alone. Just as children aren't small adults, pediatric cancer isn't just a small version of adult cancer. Caring for children with pediatric cancer involves not just addressing the unique biology, but through efforts as a community. Even seemingly small actions taken by members of the public can have important impacts for the better on pediatric cancer patients. Dr. MacQuarrie is a pediatric oncologist and physician-scientist with Ann & Robert H. Lurie Children’s Hospital of Chicago and an assistant professor of pediatrics at Northwestern’s Feinberg School of Medicine. Both his clinical and research interests focus on children with solid tumors, in particular those with sarcomas. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Pediatric Cancer: From Geometry to Community | Kyle MacQuarrie | TEDxNorthwesternU

author: TEDx Talks
description: Colour and creativity have the power to shape how we feel, think, and connect with the world around us. Drawing on experience as an illustrator and research into colour psychology, this talk explores how colour can influence mood, wellbeing, and aspiration. Too often, the spaces we live, work, and learn in prioritise function over inspiration, affecting our sense of possibility. This talk argues that colour and creativity are not luxuries but essential tools for building healthier, more connected communities. Through public art, education, and thoughtful design, we can create environments that inspire confidence, support mental wellbeing, and foster creativity. For Suffolk, investing in creative expression means strengthening community identity, inspiring future generations, and creating places people are proud to call home. Lily Hammond is a Suffolk-based illustrator and the founder of Uwu Studio ( meaning colourful studio in her grandmothers native tongue) , known for her bold, colo
title: Why Colour Matters | Lily Hammond | TEDxUniversity of Suffolk

author: TEDx Talks
description: Pharmaceutical 3D printing has the potential to transform healthcare by replacing the traditional “one-size-fits-all” approach with truly personalised medicine. Instead of standard doses, medicines can be tailored to each patient’s age, health conditions, genetics, and treatment needs, improving safety, effectiveness, and adherence. The technology can also combine multiple medications into a single tablet and work alongside digital healthcare systems to create smarter, more efficient care. For Suffolk, where an ageing population, rural healthcare challenges, and increasing pressure on NHS services are growing concerns, personalised medicine could improve access to treatment, reduce medication-related hospital admissions, and bring care closer to home. This talk explores how innovation can help create a more patient-centred and resilient healthcare system. Dr Georgina Marsh is a UK-registered pharmacist and academic leading the development of the Department of Pharmacy at the Universit
title: The end of one-size-fits-all medicine | Georgina Marsh | TEDxUniversity of Suffolk

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In architecture, what truly defines a structure is not its facade, but the void it organizes and the unseen structural system that supports it. In this compelling talk, Elif Ülger Yalçın draws parallels between architecture, entrepreneurship, and personal transformation. Sharing her journey of founding a brand from scratch, navigating crisis during the pandemic, and driving social impact, she demonstrates how real strength comes from adaptability, shared leadership, and building authentic inner foundations rather than superficial facades. Elif Ülger Yalçın is a accomplished business figure who integrates architecture, design, and entrepreneurship. A graduate of Eskişehir Osmangazi University, Department of Architecture, Yalçın continues her professional work through 2Dsign Architecture and Design Studio, and co-founded Arabica Coffee House in 2014 alongside Attorney Sertaç Yalçın. She is also a member of the TOBB Women Entrepreneurs Council.

Today, Arabica Coffee House continues its
title: Construction Within the Void | Elif Ülger Yalçın | TEDxNecmettin Erbakan University

author: TEDx Talks
description: True success is not merely defined by titles or external validation, but by finding your own rhythm and staying true to your authentic self. In this inspiring talk, Prof. Dr. Aşkın Keser reflects on his personal journey from selling simit and working in tourism as a young boy in Muğla to becoming a professor. Interweaving his life experiences with psychological theories—such as Frankl's search for meaning and Dweck's growth mindset—he demonstrates how what we often perceive as coincidences are actually the result of continuous preparation and discipline. He encourages us to focus on the journey rather than just outcomes and to discover the 'chemistry of intentions' Prof. Dr. Aşkın Keser completed his undergraduate and postgraduate education at Uludağ University, Department of Labour Economics and Industrial Relations, and the Graduate School of Social Sciences. He worked as a research assistant at Uludağ University between 1996 and 2005; he was appointed as Assistant Professor at Koca
title: Being Me | Aşkın Keser | TEDxNecmettin Erbakan University

author: TEDx Talks
description:
音乐创作可以是一种表达，也可以是一次对自我的提问。
作为深耕湖湘文化与嘻哈音乐的创作者，叶润泽分享了他如何通过音乐重新认识自己的文化和语境；也分享了如何用AI工具与自我对话，突破信息茧房，扩展思维边界。
他鼓励我们在快节奏的判断中停一下，去理解隐藏在缝隙里的另一种可能性，找到自己判断的来源与答案，也在这个过程中让新的声音进入我们的世界。
这是一场探索标准、自我与改变的演讲。他相信，分类是别人给的，而缝隙才是我们自己的。 音乐唱作人
湖湘说唱代表人物 This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: 从音乐创作到AI对话，如何成为自己的语境工程师？ | 润泽 叶 | TEDxNanshan Salon

author: TEDx Talks
description:
灯光下的舞台，是胡沈员的职业世界；门外的生活日常，是他创作的灵感之源。
作为一个摸爬滚打在排练厅十二小时的舞者，那些稀松平常的生活一瞬——母亲在站台摆手告别、深夜公交上疲惫的表情、历史小人物在沙漠中跋涉的一步，都成为舞蹈最鲜活的生命力。
他相信，真正动人的表达，不在高难度技巧中，而在专业与生活的空隙里：留白、看见、选择。这份空隙，让艺术更真切，也让人心更柔软。 中国青年舞蹈艺术家、编导 
深圳当代舞团创始人、艺术总监 This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: 空隙里的答案：生活如何化为舞台的灵感？ | 沈员 胡 | TEDxNanshan Salon

author: TEDx Talks
description: While neuroscience can map trillions of neural connections and explain how information is processed, it falls short of capturing the subjective experience of consciousness and feeling. In this talk, the concepts of thought, consciousness, knowing, and feeling are explored through the lens of modern neuroscience, the 'filter/modem' brain hypothesis of William James and Henri Bergson, and the philosophical framework of Al-Ghazali. While the brain analyzes and generates options, the heart guides our orientation, values, and choices. The speaker highlights the crucial balance between mind and heart, where knowledge transforms not into pride, but into humility and moral wisdom Associate Professor Murad Asiltürk, MD, graduated from Ankara Anatolian High School. He received his medical degree from Hacettepe University Faculty of Medicine in 1992. He completed his residency at Bakırköy Mazhar Osman Mental Health and Neurological Diseases Training and Research Hospital, becoming a Specialist i
title: The Mind's Illusion or the Heart's Truth? | Murad Asiltürk | TEDxNecmettin Erbakan University

author: TEDx Talks
description: Are we trading genuine human connection for a constant stream of digital notifications? In this talk, a heart surgeon compares modern data addiction to historic epidemics like tobacco and drug abuse, warning that isolation in the digital age poses a severe threat to our physical and mental well-being. He emphasizes that despite living in a hyper-connected world, true companionship and judicious data consumption are essential to navigate an increasingly isolated, AI-driven future. With over three decades of experience in cardiovascular and thoracic surgery, Dr. Kunal Sarkar is one of India’s leading cardiac surgeons, having performed over 40,000 heart surgeries, including more than 32,000 bypass procedures. A Fellow of the Royal Colleges of Surgeons of Edinburgh and Glasgow, he has also served as President of the Indian Association of Cardiovascular & Thoracic Surgeons. His expertise spans complex coronary surgery, minimally invasive cardiac surgery and advanced cardiovascular care. Th
title: Data is the New Addiction | Dr. Kunal Sarkar | TEDxIEM Salt Lake

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In a world overflowing with information, artificial intelligence, and instant answers, what does it truly mean to be rich?

As technology makes knowledge more accessible and machines increasingly capable of performing complex tasks, the real advantage may no longer lie in how much we know, but in how deeply we think. The ability to question assumptions, think critically, connect ideas, exercise creativity, and make independent decisions is becoming one of the most valuable human assets.

The New Rich Are People Who Can Still Think explores the growing importance of independent thought in an age of automation, algorithms, and information overload. It challenges us to look beyond conventional measures of wealth and success and recognise the value of intellectual curiosity, original thinking, sound judgment, and the courage to question what everyone else accepts. Rishu Sharma is a technology and digital transformation leader serving as Senior Director at Birlasoft. Her work lies at the i
title: The New Rich Are People Who Can Still Think | Rishu Sharma | TEDxITM Gwalior

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Aazadi for Women explores the deeper meaning of women's freedom in contemporary India, going beyond legal rights and equal opportunities to examine the social, cultural, and psychological barriers that continue to shape women's lives. 

From personal choices and financial independence to safety, dignity, equal representation, and the freedom to challenge traditional gender roles, the talk questions whether women are truly free to shape their own destinies.

It invites us to reflect on the invisible restrictions that often influence women's decisions, the expectations that limit their aspirations, and the courage required to challenge deeply rooted norms. 

More importantly, it encourages a shift from merely empowering women to creating a society where their voices are heard, their choices are respected, and their independence is supported. T.J. Bhanu is an acclaimed Indian actor, model, and creative force known for her versatility and compelling on-screen presence. From portraying the
title: Aazadi for Women | T J Bhanu | TEDxITM Gwalior

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In a society where tradition meets transformation, women are redefining leadership, challenging gender stereotypes, and reshaping the meaning of power. From navigating societal expectations and breaking barriers to claiming their identity and influencing decisions, their journeys reveal that leadership is not merely about authority or position—it is also about courage, conviction, resilience, and the ability to create meaningful change.

Leading as HER — Decoding Power in India explores the evolving landscape of women’s empowerment, gender equality, representation, and influence in contemporary India. It examines how culture, opportunity, identity, and social structures shape women’s access to power, while questioning the conventional definitions of success and leadership. The talk invites us to look beyond symbolic representation towards equal opportunities, meaningful participation, inclusive leadership, and lasting social transformation.

At its heart, this talk challenges us to re
title: Leading as "HER" : Decoding Power of in India | Sarvapriya Sangwan | TEDxITM Gwalior

author: TEDx Talks
description: This talk will help you explore why moving forward in life isn’t always about being unstoppable it’s about knowing how to restart. Drawing from his journey as a creator and entrepreneur, he reflects on the setbacks, changes, risks, and unexpected turns that have shaped the person he is today. His talk reminds us that progress doesn’t require getting everything right the first time. Sometimes, the ability to begin again, adapt, and keep showing up is what ultimately takes you forward. Jagjyot Singh is a digital creator, entrepreneur, and storyteller best known for creating relatable comedy, parodies, and cinematic content that has captivated millions across social media. As the creator behind Aapka Jags and co-founder of BanterTV, he has built a thriving online community through creativity, authenticity, and storytelling. Beyond content creation, he is the founder of Hapka, a restaurant brand, and AapkaWorks, a creative marketing agency that helps businesses tell impactful stories. Wit
title: You Don’t Have to Be Unstoppable. You Just Have to Be Restartable. | Jagjyot Singh | TEDxNKC

author: TEDx Talks
description: This talk helps you xplores how the decisions we make from a young age gradually shape the lives we build. Through his own journey from childhood choices and early ambitions to becoming an entrepreneur, investor and content creator he reflects on the importance of understanding what truly matters to you before simply following the path that seems expected. His talk, “The Alignment Advantage,” highlights how making decisions that align with your own goals, values, and definition of success can help you build a life that genuinely feels like your own. Vidhaan Jain is an entrepreneur, investor, and content creator who is passionate about making finance and business simple for India's youth. He is the founder of Wiser with Vidhaan, one of India's fastest-growing finance content platforms, reaching over 30 million views. He has also founded TheBedbox, a successful co-living startup, and has collaborated with leading brands including Unacademy, OneCard, Max Life Insurance, Binance, Scripbox
title: The Alignment Advantage: Why Most People Build the Wrong Life | Vidhaan Jain | TEDxNKC
